Guideline: Use the signature dual-stop 45deg active border gradient
Description: HYPRLAND_DECORATION_SPEC in crates/yolo-shared defines col.active_border = rgba(33ccffee) rgba(00ff99ee) 45deg and col.inactive_border = rgba(595959aa) with border_size = 2
Do: Emit m3-hyprland.conf via bun ui theme --preset hyprland --target hyprland or use --hypr-active-border-start (#33ccff) and --hypr-active-border-end (#00ff99) on focused surfaces
Don't: Use thick 6px solid borders or low-contrast active borders that make the focused tiled window indistinguishable

Guideline: Configure dual-kawase blur (size 8, passes 3, vibrancy 0.1696) with readable surface alpha
Description: Hyprland's decoration:blur uses multi-pass dual-kawase blur; translucent app surfaces (0.78–0.88 alpha) need sufficient contrast over dynamic wallpapers
Do: Pair blur { enabled = true; size = 8; passes = 3; vibrancy = 0.1696 } with dark abyss surfaces (#0b0e14 / #111622 at 85% alpha) so text maintains >=4.5:1 contrast
Don't: Set window opacity below 0.50 over bright wallpapers or use blur passes > 5 which drains GPU power on laptops
Code Good: blur { enabled = true; size = 8; passes = 3; vibrancy = 0.1696 }
Code Bad: blur { size = 20; passes = 8 } // extreme GPU drain

Guideline: Align window rounding (10px) and gaps (gaps_in 5, gaps_out 20) with app chrome
Description: HYPRLAND_DECORATION_SPEC and YoloStyle::for_preset(YoloThemePreset::Hyprland) use rounding = 10px, border_size = 2px, gaps_in = 5px, gaps_out = 20px
Do: Match internal card/panel corner radii (8px–12px) and omit redundant outer window titlebars when tiled under Hyprland
Don't: Draw a second rounded window frame with outer transparent margins inside a tiled Wayland surface
Code Bad: // double window borders and client-side shadow margins when tiled

Guideline: Use the canonical Hyprland bezier curve (0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05) and respect reduced motion
Description: HYPRLAND_DECORATION_SPEC defines bezier = myBezier, 0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05 for snappy spring-like window and workspace transitions
Do: Use cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05) for in-app drawer/modal transitions so app motion matches compositor window animations
Don't: Use slow linear animations (>500ms) that feel sluggish next to Hyprland's workspace switching

Guideline: Unify hyprtoolkit, hyprqt6engine, hyprlauncher and hyprlock
Description: submodules/hyprtoolkit, submodules/hyprqt6engine, submodules/hyprlauncher and submodules/hyprlock share the same Hyprwm palette tokens
Do: Generate unified Hyprland + Qt6 + GTK4 + CSS configs via crates/yolo-emit so Qt6 (hyprqt6engine), GTK4, and native hyprtoolkit surfaces share one scheme
Don't: Configure Qt6 and GTK4 apps with unrelated themes that clash inside a Hyprland session

Guideline: Integrate cleanly with Wayland desktop shells (Wayle, Caelestia, Noctalia, Bedina)
Description: Yolo UI bundles submodules/wayle, submodules/caelestia-shell, submodules/noctalia, submodules/bedina and submodules/awesome-hyprland for bars, notifications and OSDs
Do: Use wlr-layer-shell / ext-session-lock protocols for panels, docks, wallpapers and lockscreens
Don't: Use regular top-level X11/Wayland windows positioned with fixed coordinates for status bars or overlays

Code Bad: // regular window trying to set_position(0, 0) on Wayland

Guideline: Ensure all app windows resize fluidly down to narrow split tiles
Description: In a dwindle or master tiling layout, windows are frequently split to 1/2 or 1/4 screen width without fixed minimum sizes
Do: Test layouts at 360px–600px width and collapse sidebars into drawers or rails automatically
Don't: Set min_inner_size(1280, 800) which forces tiled windows to overflow or float unexpectedly
Code Good: // adaptive layout that collapses rail below 600px

Guideline: Run natively on Wayland (Ozone / GDK / Winit / Qt Wayland)
Description: XWayland introduces scaling blur on fractional HiDPI displays and breaks touchpad gestures
Do: Use native Wayland backends (ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=wayland, WINIT_UNIX_BACKEND=wayland, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=wayland)
Code Bad: env = GDK_BACKEND,x11 // blurry under fractional scale

Guideline: Search submodules/awesome-hyprland for plugins, shaders and widgets
Description: submodules/awesome-hyprland curates official hyprwm plugins (hyprbars, hyprexpo, hyprtrails), bars (Waybar, AGS/Astal, Eww, Wayle), and launchers
Do: Query bun ui awesome hyprland to discover vetted Wayland components and configurations
Don't: Write fragile screen-scraping scripts instead of using Hyprland's IPC socket ($HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE)
Code Bad: // parsing hyprctl stdout with regex in a tight loop instead of socket2 events
